acquisition method: up to 20 dynamically chosen, most abundant, precursor ions were fragmented
alkylation reagent: followed by addition of iodoacetamide (100 mM at 1/10th sample volume) for 30 min in the dark at room temperature.
alkylation concentration: followed by addition of iodoacetamide (100 mM at 1/10th sample volume)
cleavage agent: before addition of trypsin at 1:20 trypsin:protein ratio.
collision energy: followed by higher energy collisional dissociation based fragmentation (normalised collision energy 28).
fractionation method: Trypsin digested peptides from these pools were separated offline by high pH reverse phase chromatography into 15 fractions prior to online LC-MS/MS.
fragmentation method: followed by higher energy collisional dissociation based fragmentation (normalised collision energy 28).
instrument: MS analyses were performed on a Q Exactive Plus mass spectrometer (ThermoFisher Scientific)
labeling: Here, we exploited label-free quantitative tandem mass-spectrometry proteomics to create an in-depth proteomic survey of adult human brain regions.
reduction reagent: Dithiothreitol (45 mM at 1/10th sample volume) was added to lysates for 30 min at 37°C
reduction concentration: Dithiothreitol (45 mM at 1/10th sample volume) was added to lysates
